exposure: Accordance of delivery with desired delivery method
cohort: This study included 375 postpartum women who had experienced psychological traumatic childbirth according to criterion A of the fifth edition of Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5 [A]).
finding: The study found that type of delivery, accordance of the delivery with the desired delivery method, and analgesia use were significant predictors of childbirth satisfaction in women who had experienced psychological traumatic childbirth.
